mapper.select:
select s.name_kana as supplier, prd.supplier_id , s.name as supplier_name , count(prd.pr_detail_id) as detail_count , unnest(array_agg( distinct pr.display_number order by pr.display_number asc )) as pr_display_number , sum(prd.subtotal_excluding_tax) as total_amount_excluding_tax from purchase_request pr join purchase_request_detail prd on pr.pr_id = prd.pr_id join supplier s on prd.supplier_id = s.supplier_id where prd.snap_kind = #{itemKind}
and s.supplier_id = #{form.supplierId}
group by prd.supplier_id , s.name , s.name_kana
union all
select prd.snap_supplier_name as supplier, string_agg(prd.supplier_id, '') as supplier_id , prd.snap_supplier_name as supplier_name , count(prd.pr_detail_id) as detail_count , unnest(array_agg( distinct pr.display_number order by pr.display_number asc )) as pr_display_number , sum(prd.subtotal_excluding_tax) as total_amount_excluding_tax from purchase_request pr join purchase_request_detail prd on pr.pr_id = prd.pr_id where prd.supplier_id is null and prd.snap_kind = #{itemKind} group by prd.snap_supplier_name
order by
supplier
detail_count
total_amount_excluding_tax
, supplier asc , supplier_name asc , supplier_id asc , pr_display_number asc
